title: Casimir-force spectroscopy of broadband optical response
summary: Broadband optical response governs light-matter interactions across photonics, plasmonics, thermal radiation, and quantum fluctuation electrodynamics, yet determining a continuous dielectric function over many decades in frequency typically requires combining multiple spectroscopies, extrapolations, and material models. Here we show that quantum-fluctuation forces provide a route to broadband optical characterization.
